#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353LL;

vector<long long> fact(1, 1);
vector<long long> invFact(1, 1);

long long modPow(long long a, long long e) {
    long long res = 1;
    while (e > 0) {
        if (e & 1) res = res * a % MOD;
        a = a * a % MOD;
        e >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

void ensureFact(int n) {
    while ((int)fact.size() <= n) {
        fact.push_back(fact.back() * (int)fact.size() % MOD);
    }
}

void ensureInvFact(int n) {
    int last = (int)invFact.size() - 1;
    if (last < n) {
        long long fn = fact[n];
        long long invFn = modPow(fn, MOD - 2);
        vector<long long> tmp(n - last);
        tmp[0] = invFn;
        for (int i = 1; i < (int)tmp.size(); i++) {
            tmp[i] = tmp[i - 1] * (n - i + 1) % MOD;
        }
        for (int i = (int)tmp.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            invFact.push_back(tmp[i]);
        }
    }
}

long long factN(int n) {
    ensureFact(n);
    return fact[n];
}

long long invFactN(int n) {
    ensureInvFact(n);
    return invFact[n];
}

long long ncr(int n, int r) {
    if (r < 0 || n < r) return 0;
    return factN(n) * invFactN(r) % MOD * invFactN(n - r) % MOD;
}

long long smallInv(int n) {
    return invFactN(n) * factN(n - 1) % MOD;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;

    // Precompute factorials up to n+m
    fact.resize(1, 1);
    invFact.resize(1, 1);
    ensureFact(n + m);
    ensureInvFact(n + m);

    long long phaseSize = 1;
    long long p = 1;
    for (int i = 0; p != 0; i++) {
        p = p * (n - i) % MOD * smallInv(n + m - i) % MOD;
        phaseSize = (phaseSize + p) % MOD;
    }

    long long answer = 0;
    for (int k = 1; k <= n; k++) {
        long long numPhases = (m + k) * smallInv(k) % MOD;
        long long e = numPhases * phaseSize % MOD;
        long long term = ncr(n, k) * e % MOD;
        if (k % 2 == 1)
            answer = (answer + term) % MOD;
        else
            answer = (answer - term + MOD) % MOD;
    }

    cout << answer << endl;
    return 0;
}
